why: Stretch pants, leggings, tees and outdoor layers for yoga, hiking and travel, for women and men, women's pants around $98, sold through wholesale and its own stores and site.

doors.note: Locator is a static page: 4 'our stores' (Burlingame, San Diego/La Jolla, Boulder, Portland) + 3 outlets. Burlingame has no address or page (row kept, ZIP NC). La Jolla page has no ZIP. Separate 'Authorized Dealers' locator (/dealer-locator) for wholesale — not counted.

tech_evidence.owned: house trademarks (™); LYCRA®, TENCEL™, Liva Reviva™ licensed fibres; bluesign® approved fabrics

craft_evidence.makers: not on the brand pages; the supply chain list is 'published' (2019) per /sustainability.html
craft_evidence.process: partial — dated timeline of material and labour commitments (Fair Labor Association 2010, first Fair Trade Certified™ apparel 2011, Canopy, RDS, RWS, Regenerative Organic Certified® cotton 2023); blue
craft_evidence.reasoning: A dated house with a long, specific sourcing and labour record and a published supplier list, but no maker, factory or country appears on the store, and every product page says only 'Imported'. 2 — the same footing as FARM Rio's published list (3 if a published list counts).
